directives.topic: META Q3 Earnings Scenario Matrix: October 28 Binary Event Modeling
directives.why: October 28 is the single most important event for the portfolio. With 54% concentration, need a detailed bear/base/bull scenario map: (1) What does a 'beat + strong Muse conversion data' print do to the stock — can it push toward $860 Cantor target? (2) What does a 'miss + CapEx hike' print do — realistic downside from $737? (3) What is the paid conversion rate the market needs to see from Muse (minimum threshold)? (4) What CapEx guidance number would be received as 'too high' vs. 'appropriate investment'? Model the after-hours move distribution based on comparable earnings events.

directives.topic: PCE Wednesday + Jobs Friday: TBT/Bond Market Impact Assessment
directives.why: PCE (Wednesday Sept 30) and September jobs (Friday Oct 2) are the binary macro events that will cement or undermine October rate hike odds. Core PCE expected +0.3% MoM, 3.3% annualized. Jobs expected +90-100K. If both print hot, October hike is certain and TBT should rally. If jobs disappoint (<50K), the Fed may pause and TBT faces headwinds. Need a real-time read on these prints as soon as they release.

directives.topic: CrowdStrike / AI Cybersecurity Deep Dive: Entry Timing and Valuation
directives.why: CRWD is a genuine structural growth story — 26% revenue growth, $5.84B ARR, AI agent security as a new attack surface. But I need to know: (1) What is the valuation — forward P/S, EV/Revenue vs. peers? (2) When does CRWD report Q3 earnings — is there a near-term catalyst? (3) Is there a better entry point — where does CRWD tend to pull back to after runs? (4) How does PANW compare as an alternative or complement? This is a watch-list position I want to size properly when the entry is right.

directives.topic: Hormuz Peace Process: Oil Shock Unwind Scenario and Portfolio Impact
directives.why: Qatar is still mediating as of September 29. A Hormuz deal — even a partial one — would be a multi-sigma oil price shock downward (Brent from $105 toward $80?). This would: (1) reduce inflation pressure → potentially reduce Fed hiking urgency → bearish for TBT (need to know how fast and how much), (2) relieve energy cost pressure on consumers → bullish for META advertising revenue, (3) potentially hurt energy-linked plays. Need a current status update on Qatar mediation, Iran's stated conditions, and the realistic probability of a deal in the next 30-60 days.

directives.topic: AMD Venice CPU Commercial Traction: First Revenue Data and Competitive Threats
directives.why: Venice launched July 22-23 and should be generating first commercial revenue in Q3. AMD reports earnings in late October. Need to know: (1) What are analysts projecting for Venice CPU revenue contribution in Q3? (2) How is the Meta warrant structure structured — which milestone tranches have been hit, which remain? (3) Are other hyperscalers (Google, Microsoft) adopting Venice or staying with ARM/x86 alternatives? (4) What is Nvidia's response to the CPU inference thesis — are they building inference-optimized silicon that threatens AMD's positioning?
